verses.ar:
بَلَغَ الْعُلَا بِكَمَالِهِ ۞ كَشَفَ الدُّجَى بِجَمَالِهِ
حَسُنَتْ جَمِيعُ خِصَالِهِ ۞ صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ (2)
verses.tr:
Balagha-l-ʿulā bi-kamālihi · kashafa-d-dujā bi-jamālihi
Ḥasunat jamīʿu khiṣālihi · ṣallū ʿalayhi wa-ālihi (2)
verses.en:
He reached the highest in perfection; He removed the darkness with his beauty
All his qualities are beautiful, send peace and blessings upon him! (2)

verses.ar: لَاحَ الْحَبِيبُ بِوَجْهِهِ الْمُتَأَلِّقِ قَمَرًا ۞ وَفِي أُفُقِ الْبَهَاءِ لَمْ يُلْحَقِ
verses.tr: Lāḥa-l-ḥabību bi-wajhihi-l-muta'alliqi qamaran · wa fī ufuqi-l-bahā'i lam yulḥaqi
verses.en:
The Beloved appeared with his radiant face
As a moon on a horizon of splendour, unsurpassed

verses.ar: أَهْدَيْتَ لِلْأَكْوَانِ كُلَّ سَعَادَةٍ ۞ يَا صَاحِبَ الْوَجْهِ الْمُنِيرِ الْمُشْرِقِ
verses.tr: Ahdayta li-l-akwāni kulla saʿādatin · yā ṣāḥiba-l-wajhi-l-munīri-l-mushriqi
verses.en:
You gifted all existent things with complete (eternal) felicity
O possessor of a face so shining and resplendent

verses.ar: يَا سَيِّدًا طَابَتْ عَنَاصِرُ أَصْلِهِ ۞ وَحَلَتْ مَذَاقَتُهَا لَدَى الْمُتَذَوِّقِ
verses.tr: Yā sayyidan ṭābat ʿanāṣiru aṣlihi · wa ḥalat madhāqatuhā lada-l-mutadhawwiqi
verses.en:
O master, whose origin is pure and agreeable
It is most sweet in taste to he who savours it

verses.ar: يَا رَحْمَةً يَا نِعْمَةً يَا مِنْحَةً ۞ بِعُرَاكَ كَانَ تَمَسُّكِي وَتَعَلُّقِي
verses.tr: Yā raḥmatan yā niʿmatan yā minḥatan · bi-ʿurāka kāna tamassukī wa taʿalluqī
verses.en:
O mercy, O bounty, O gift
To your reliable grip is my devotion and attachment

verses.ar: وَبُعِثْتَ لِلثَّقَلَيْنِ أَعْظَمَ رَاحِمٍ ۞ بَلْ أَنْتَ لِلْعَاصِينَ أَشْفَقُ مُشْفِقٍ
verses.tr: Wa buʿithta li-th-thaqalayni aʿẓama rāḥimin · bal anta li-l-ʿāṣīna ashfaqu mushfiqin
verses.en:
You were sent to humankind and the jinn, showing the greatest mercy
Nay, even to disobedient sinners you are concerned and tender

verses.ar: عَطْفًا عَلٰى مَنْ بَاتَ فِيكَ مُهَيَّمًا ۞ وَلِغَيْرِ بَابِكَ دَهْرَهُ لَمْ يَطْرُقِ
verses.tr: ʿAṭfan ʿalā man bāta fīka muhayyaman · wa li-ghayri bābika dahrahu lam yaṭruqi
verses.en:
Take pity on one who has remained madly in love with you
Who never knocked on any door besides yours
